name: Conan Exiles
description: Open-world survival in the brutal lands of Conan the Barbarian. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); the server binary is a Windows executable.

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: The server also uses game port + 1 (raw UDP traffic).

notes: The install always fetches the Windows depot (platformOverride) — on Linux hosts run it with Wine/Proton (start command override: wine ConanSandboxServer.exe ... with the same arguments). Also open UDP game port + 1 (default 7778). Set AdminPassword and other settings in ConanSandbox/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/ServerSettings.ini (created on first start). Database/saves live in ConanSandbox/Saved/.
